text: もうすこしで　つかまえられたのに！

structure.en: I could have caught it, but

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに says 'even though' and shows regret or frustration. つかまえられたのに = 'I could have caught it, but...'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: られる on a verb means 'can do'. つかまえられた = 'was able to catch'.
